category_title: Struggling readers who use speech recognition to test and confirm their own diction
scenario_title: Deleting entire drafts due to SR inaccuracies and skipping the writing process
minimal_context: The student is at the writing center using a speech recognition tool to dictate complete ideas.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's work on your story at the writing center. You can use the speech recognition tool to dictate your complete ideas.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I want to skip brainstorming and drafting. I am just going to dictate my complete ideas into the microphone.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, go ahead and try that.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: The speech recognition was inaccurate. It didn't type my complete idea right.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think you should do next?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Deletes the entire draft) I am deleting the entire sentence and draft. To me, what I dictate is the final composition.

TUTOR: Let's work on your story at the writing center. You can use the speech recognition tool to dictate your complete ideas.

STUDENT: I want to skip brainstorming and drafting. I am just going to dictate my complete ideas into the microphone.

STUDENT: (Deletes the entire draft) I am deleting the entire sentence and draft. To me, what I dictate is the final composition.
